paragraphs.zh: Mit den äußeren Bedingungen wie Temperatur, Feuchtigkeit, der Art des verwendeten Herbizids, u.a. variiert die erforderliche Aufwandmenge der Verbindungen der Formel (I). Sie kann innerhalb weiter Grenzen schwanken, z.B. zwischen 0,001 und 10,0 kg/ha oder mehr Aktivsubstanz, vorzugsweise liegt sie jedoch zwischen 0,005 und 5 kg/ha.
paragraphs.en: The application rate of the compounds of the formula (I) required varies with the external conditions such as temperature, humidity, the nature of the herbicide used, among others. It can vary within wide limits, for example between 0.001 and 10.0 kg/ha or more of active substance, but preferably it lies between 0.005 and 5 kg/ha.
paragraphs.notes: First paragraph on the page; it is the end of the application-rate discussion carried over from the preceding page. Decimal commas are as printed. A small stray ink mark sits between this line and the next, under 'schwanken, z.B.'; it is a scan artifact, not a character.

paragraphs.zh: 200 g (1.24 mol) 2,6-Dichlortoluol wurden in 600 ml Hexamethylphosphorsäuretriamid gelöst und mit  130.41 g (1,86 mol) Natriumthiomethylat versetzt. Anschließend wurde für 3 h auf 100 °C erhitzt. Man ließ abkühlen, fügte 88.2 g (0.5 mol) Jodmethan hinzu und ließ 0,5 h bei Raumtemperatur nachrühren. Anschließend wurde der Ansatz auf 3.5 l Wasser gegeben und mit Essigester extrahiert. Die vereinigten organischen Phasen wurden mit Wasser gewaschen, über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt.
paragraphs.en: 200 g (1.24 mol) of 2,6-dichlorotoluene were dissolved in 600 ml of hexamethylphosphoric triamide and 130.41 g (1.86 mol) of sodium thiomethylate were added. The mixture was then heated to 100 °C for 3 h. It was allowed to cool, 88.2 g (0.5 mol) of iodomethane were added and the mixture was stirred for a further 0.5 h at room temperature. The batch was then poured onto 3.5 l of water and extracted with ethyl acetate. The combined organic phases were washed with water, dried over MgSO4 and evaporated to dryness on a rotary evaporator.
paragraphs.notes: Decimal separators are mixed exactly as printed: '1.24 mol' and '3.5 l' and '208.85 g' use a point, '1,86 mol' and '0,5 h' use a comma. The double space before '130.41' is as printed. The 4 in MgSO4 is printed as a subscript; rendered inline because the transcription is plain text. 'Essigester' is the German trivial name for ethyl acetate. The printed gram/mole pairing for Jodmethan, 88.2 g (0.5 mol), is transcribed as printed and not reconciled with the molar mass of CH3I.

paragraphs.zh: 47.36 g (0.60 mol) Acetylchlorid in 200 ml 1,2-Dichlorethan wurden bei 15-20 °C zu einer Suspension von 90.79 g (0.68 Mol) Aluminiumchlorid in 200 ml 1,2-Dichlorethan getropft. Anschließend wurde eine Lösung von 103.14 g (0.60 mol) 2-Chlor-6-methylthiotoluol in 400 ml 1,2-Dichlorethan zugetropft. Man ließ über Nacht bei Raumtemperatur rühren und gab das Reaktionsgemisch auf eine Mischung von 1 l Eis und 300 ml konz. Salzsäure. Es wurde mit Methylenchlorid extrahiert. Die vereinigten organischen Phasen wurden mit Wasser gewaschen, über MgSO4 getrocknet und am Rotationsverdampfer vollständig eingeengt. Der Rückstand wurde im Vakuum destilliert.
paragraphs.en: 47.36 g (0.60 mol) of acetyl chloride in 200 ml of 1,2-dichloroethane were added dropwise at 15-20 °C to a suspension of 90.79 g (0.68 mol) of aluminium chloride in 200 ml of 1,2-dichloroethane. A solution of 103.14 g (0.60 mol) of 2-chloro-6-methylthiotoluene in 400 ml of 1,2-dichloroethane was then added dropwise. The mixture was stirred overnight at room temperature and the reaction mixture was poured onto a mixture of 1 l of ice and 300 ml of concentrated hydrochloric acid. It was extracted with methylene chloride. The combined organic phases were washed with water, dried over MgSO4 and evaporated to dryness on a rotary evaporator. The residue was distilled under vacuum.
paragraphs.notes: The dash in the printed temperature range '15-20 °C' is set as an en dash on the page, longer than the hyphens in '1,2-Dichlorethan'; it is transcribed as a plain hyphen because this repo's style bans the long dash characters. 'Mol' is capitalised in '(0.68 Mol)' and lower case in the other two, exactly as printed. The 4 in MgSO4 is a printed subscript. The paragraph ends the page; the step 2 yield and analytical data are not on this page.
